offering_description.value: Licenses stock photos, editorial images, video and music to media companies, businesses, agencies and consumers. Content comes from its own photographers and a network of contributors and partners, and is delivered through websites, subscriptions and enterprise accounts.

primary_products.value: licensed stock photos; editorial photography; stock video footage; licensed music; archival images

primary_services.value: editorial event coverage; creative content commissioning; content licensing and asset management; AI-generated imagery tools

customer_segment.value: B2B: media and publishers, advertising agencies, corporations, and small businesses; B2C: individual buyers and creators purchasing images online; B2G: government agencies and public institutions licensing imagery

end_markets.value: media and publishing; advertising and marketing; corporate communications; e-commerce; education

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: per-image and per-clip licenses for stock and editorial content; subscription: subscription plans and enterprise agreements for content access; service fees: commissioned shoots and event coverage
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: aggregates images from staff and contributor photographers and archives, licensed to media, agencies and corporations; software / platform: online marketplace and platform that delivers and licenses content

geography_served.value: global: Customers in more than 200 countries, with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Editorial and creative images, video, music, and the iStock and Unsplash platforms

distribution_channels.value: online: Getty Images, iStock and Unsplash websites and APIs; direct sales: sales teams serving enterprise, media and agency accounts; partners / resellers: distribution partners and resellers in local markets

regulatory_exposure.value: low: Normal business rules apply, including copyright, privacy and publicity rights, and data protection laws

notes: Getty Images announced a merger with Shutterstock; I'm not sure it has closed, so I described Getty alone.
